pages.title: Reaching Space
pages.text: Create: Northstar adds a solar system as dimensions: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus, plus an orbit above each planet. You get there with a rocket built from Create parts, or by flying an Aeronautics ship upward. Either way you first need a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/why)[#]().

pages.title: Two ways up
pages.text: A Northstar rocket is a contraption glued around a Rocket Station. An Aeronautics ship uses a Dimensional Drive or Stellar Navigator instead. All three are built around a Stellar Core. See [#](2E5AAC)[Rockets](entry://space/rocket_building)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Ship Bridges](entry://space/aeronautics_bridge)[#]().

pages.title: Before you go
pages.text: Destinations come from the **Space Atlas**. Planets unlock as you add science to it from Astronomical Readings. Landing on a planet needs an Interplanetary Navigator aboard; the Moon does not, since it is a moon.

pages.title: Space Atlas
pages.text: Holds coordinates of bodies and saved waypoints. Put it in a Rocket Station to set the destination.
A Book and a Titanium Ingot.

pages.title: Telescope
pages.text: Hold to take an astronomical reading. Needs night and 1 Paper. It does not work in every dimension.

pages.title: Astronomy Table
pages.text: Turns readings into science for the atlas. Readings of different planets are worth more, and one planet gives one reading per day.

pages.title: Where next
pages.text: Titanium is the key metal here, replacing iron plates in much of the tech. See [#](2E5AAC)[Space Metals](entry://space/space_materials)[#](). Oxygen and suits are in [#](2E5AAC)[Oxygen and Suits](entry://space/space_survival)[#]().
